scope: Scientific plan and code-generation audit specification only
machine_handoff: This comparison design is not a model-plan.schema.json record. After review, bind each actual prepared input/fold/task with a fresh skill plan and real authorization; do not pass this envelope to run-tool.
question: Does adding geographic proxies to an identical environmental predictor set improve reproducible long-term ozone prediction under matched benchmark and spatial-transfer conditions?

estimands.name: paired fixed-setting contrast
estimands.definition: Compare both arms for every identical parameter/seed/fold specification; do not select the best setting from outer results.
estimands.interpretation: An algorithmic feature-set contrast, not a causal effect.

estimands.name: equal-budget tuned-pipeline contrast
estimands.definition: Select each arm independently using the same inner folds, candidates and selection rule; evaluate frozen pipelines on matched outer samples.
estimands.interpretation: Difference includes the selected hyperparameters; do not attribute it solely to coordinates.

variables.reason: Represent elevation-associated exposure and transport/background differences.
variables.uncertainty: Elevation is a proxy, not a direct measurement of mixing or chemistry.
variables.alternative: Remove altitude as an ablation or add validated meteorological fields in a separately reviewed expansion.

variables.reason: Distinguish local topographic position from absolute elevation.
variables.uncertainty: Retain the source definition; it is not boundary-layer height or an intervention.
variables.alternative: Compare altitude alone with both elevation fields inside development validation.

variables.physical_meaning: Water-cover fraction in the source 25 km neighbourhood
variables.reason: Represent coastal/water-surface context that can differ from land-dominated sites.
variables.uncertainty: Does not measure sea-breeze circulation; 25 km is the source support, not a validation distance.
variables.alternative: Test removing this context proxy after the main prespecified comparison.

variables.physical_meaning: Sum of five mutually exclusive forest-cover fractions
variables.reason: Retain broad vegetation/surface context without treating five forest subclasses as separate search choices.
variables.uncertainty: Aggregation loses species-dependent emissions and deposition; the sum is not a VOC flux.
variables.alternative: Keep five forest types separately or use another source-defined aggregation in a separate feature-design comparison.

variables.physical_meaning: Grassland-cover fraction in the source neighbourhood
variables.reason: Represent a land-cover setting different from forest, crops and built-up land.
variables.uncertainty: Cover alone does not determine vegetation emissions or uptake rates.
variables.alternative: Assess removal of this land-cover context within development data.

variables.physical_meaning: Cropland-cover fraction in the source neighbourhood
variables.reason: Represent agricultural land-cover context within the available metadata.
variables.uncertainty: Not a fertilizer input, crop calendar or causal agricultural effect.
variables.alternative: Assess removal or a reviewed agricultural-process input when available.

variables.physical_meaning: Built-up-cover fraction in the source neighbourhood
variables.reason: Include a prespecified human-activity setting alongside the precursor inventory.
variables.uncertainty: Can overlap NOx information and encode location; its retention is a hypothesis, not a published universal selection.
variables.alternative: Test a no-built-up ablation because it may overlap precursor information.

variables.reason: Include an available ozone-precursor measure instead of relying entirely on location or activity proxies.
variables.uncertainty: Not ambient NOx concentration; response may be non-monotone and depends on VOCs, radiation and transport.
variables.alternative: Add independently justified chemistry/meteorology or defer the inventory if source reconciliation fails.

variables.reason: Test added geographic proxy information in the coordinate arm only.
variables.uncertainty: Not temperature, radiation or a causal geographic effect.
variables.alternative: Exclude location entirely as in arm A; an absolute-latitude model is a different optional hypothesis.

variables.reason: Encode longitude without a numeric jump at the date line.
variables.uncertainty: Circular encoding does not prevent spatial memorization; interpret together with lon_cos.
variables.alternative: Use raw longitude only as an explicitly separate date-line sensitivity, not as a silent replacement.

variables.uncertainty: Do not vary this independently of lon_sin for geographic response interpretation.
variables.alternative: Use a reviewed joint geographic representation rather than dropping one member of the circular pair.

exclusions.reason: Keep keys/group labels as metadata; avoid introducing additional geographic or siting-category predictors in this controlled first comparison.
Defer until source units/support and extreme values are reconciled; do not silently rescale, clip or declare the source invalid.
Deferred to a separate expansion after product scale/version or categorical-boundary review; exclusion is not evidence of irrelevance.

exclusions.columns: remaining land-cover subclasses, production and other metadata
exclusions.reason: Bound the first hypothesis set; do not treat this deliberately limited environmental set as complete atmospheric information.

exclusions.columns: new temperature/radiation or other external products
exclusions.reason: Not present in the selected input contract; needs separate temporal/support and lineage checks before acquisition.

preprocessing.choice: Preserve source and stable id; materialize a fresh versioned prepared input after approval.
preprocessing.reason: Paired arms must reference identical samples and provenance.

preprocessing.choice: Convert declared missing markers to missing; never impute the target.
preprocessing.reason: Missing outcome values are not observations.

preprocessing.choice: forest_25km = sum of the five forest fields only when all five are non-missing.
preprocessing.reason: Transparent deterministic aggregation; no missing component is replaced by zero.

preprocessing.choice: lon_sin = sin(lon*pi/180); lon_cos = cos(lon*pi/180); keep signed lat.
preprocessing.reason: Respect circular longitude; this does not ensure spatial generalization.

preprocessing.choice: No scaling, clipping, winsorization or outcome transformation; retain valid negative elevations and zero fractions.
preprocessing.reason: Tree splits do not require standardization; changing physical support needs separate evidence.

preprocessing.choice: Review out-of-range fractions/coordinates or negative emissions; do not silently correct them. Pair row exclusions by stable id.
preprocessing.reason: Both arms must retain the same valid target cohort and documented quality rules.

preprocessing.choice: Fit any needed numeric median on each fit-training subset only; manual declared features, no outcome-driven or VIF-only deletion.
preprocessing.reason: Avoid preprocessing leakage and an order-dependent feature-filter confound.

omitted_and_implementation_defaults.max.depth: Omitted: ranger's unrestricted depth, not an implicit validated depth optimum.
omitted_and_implementation_defaults.splitrule: Variance regression default under the reviewed mlr3/ranger versions.

reasons.reason: 3 is near sqrt(p) for p=8 or 11; 6 tests stronger feature competition. Match absolute values across arms to keep the explicit parameter contrast controlled.
reasons.uncertainty: Fractions differ across p; this is not equal split-inclusion probability or a proven optimum.
reasons.alternative: Use p-relative mtry values in a separate equal-fraction sensitivity; do not mix that with the fixed-count contrast.

reasons.reason: 5 is a conventional regression reference; 25 is a deliberately five-times-coarser splitting threshold for noisy, clustered station labels and a small search budget.
reasons.uncertainty: 25 is a study proposal, not a literature optimum; ranger can create leaves smaller than this value.
reasons.alternative: Try an intermediate or stronger threshold only after a bounded design revision, not outer-score-driven tuning.

reasons.reason: Conventional feasible starting forest size, explicitly set to avoid the runner's omitted-value fallback of 100.
reasons.uncertainty: Stability is not established. Development-only comparisons at 250/500/1000 trees are proposed diagnostics, not completed tuning.
reasons.alternative: Use a separately approved development-only stability extension at 250 and 1000 trees.

reasons.reason: Use ranger's conventional without-replacement fraction, make distinct-row sampling explicit and hold it fixed to keep only two primary search axes.
reasons.uncertainty: Not calibrated to this dataset and not a group-aware sampling method; rare conditions may lose support.
reasons.alternative: Compare other fractions or replacement schemes in a separate declared search rather than expanding this grid silently.

reasons.reason: Avoid introducing an unsupported fixed depth inherited from history; node size is the declared primary complexity axis.
reasons.uncertainty: Unrestricted depth is not proof against overfitting; investigate development diagnostics before expanding the design.
reasons.alternative: Compare depth constraints in development if the node-size axis fails to control fit.

reasons.reason: Use identical task seeds, model order and fold identities across arms; isolate model-seed variation from cohort sampling.
reasons.uncertainty: These are reproducibility constants, not scientific tuning parameters. Record effective candidate seeds, not only the base seed. Equal initial/effective seeds do not ensure identical per-tree draws when different feature sets consume random numbers.
reasons.alternative: Different reproducibility seeds may be declared before fitting; never retain only favorable repeats.

reasons.reason: Ozone errors in ppb; RMSE penalizes large errors, with MAE and region-specific bias also reported.
reasons.uncertainty: Choosing by MAE would not alter the variance-based forest fitting loss.
reasons.alternative: Select by MAE under a revised objective and still report RMSE.

choice.reason: Secondary bounded response diagnostics; not evidence of scientific convergence or causal identification.

reasons.reason: Keep secondary shared-variable diagnostics bounded and reproducible; do not request invalid independent longitude-component response plots.
reasons.uncertainty: This budget is an engineering starting point. Joint coordinate importance and explanation convergence are not implemented or established.
reasons.alternative: Increase explanation budgets or request joint coordinate permutation only with reviewed implementation and support checks.

stability_diagnostic.comparisons: Common specified settings and seeds across both arms.
stability_diagnostic.decision: Report prediction/loss variation. Revise an unstable design before outer evaluation; do not choose settings from outer scores.

parameter_design.baseline: Training mean, identical cohort in each paired comparison.

explanation_budget.reason: Secondary bounded response diagnostics; not evidence of scientific convergence or causal identification.

benchmark.purpose: Compatibility and paired algorithmic comparison, not new independent scientific acceptance.
benchmark.split: Preserve supplied dataset labels and all usable rows; row caps equal source counts before exclusions.
benchmark.warning: The published split uses spatial clustering, but nearest training distances are not universally at least 50 km. Prior test results have been seen.

spatial_transfer.purpose: New-region transfer sensitivity on the 4462 source train+val stations; not deployment-matched interpolation accuracy.

inner.grouping: Equal-area EPSG:6933 cells of 250000 m, origin (0,0); never split a cell across validation folds.
inner.assignment: Sort cell groups deterministically by descending station count; tie-break by public cell key and assign to the currently smallest fold; no outcome-based balancing.
inner.distance: Spherical great-circle distance with radius 6371.0088 km; remove training sites <50 km from validation sites.
inner.guard: Generate and inspect fold/block counts and closest cross-fold distances before fitting. If coverage/folds are infeasible, return for plan revision; do not lower distances after seeing model scores.

spatial_transfer.distance_reason: 250 km cells plus a 50 km buffer are explicit study-design starting choices, not literature-proven independence scales. Whole-region outer holdouts define transfer; sensitivity to scale needs a separate bounded extension.
spatial_transfer.selection: For each outer holdout and arm, pool inner out-of-fold squared errors over the same observations and all three declared model seeds; select minimum pooled RMSE; exact ties use declared candidate order. Freeze the choice before any outer scoring.
spatial_transfer.refit: After inner selection is frozen, refit all four prespecified fixed settings for E1 on all eligible buffered outer-training data; the matching selected fit supplies E2. Never retain an inner-fold model as final refit. Outer outcomes do not select any setting.
spatial_transfer.outer_reporting: Report each region, paired fixed-setting contrasts and equal-budget tuned-pipeline contrasts separately; pool station-level errors only with a declared site-weighted estimand. Do not average RMSE values and call that pooled RMSE.
spatial_transfer.independence: A reanalysis of a previously explored benchmark is not a newly untouched external validation. Only three region holdouts do not establish a global uncertainty interval.
spatial_transfer.implementation: Not implemented by the current single-task controller; requires reviewed reusable preparation/resampling/development-only fit/refit helpers in skills before experiment-code generation.

interpolation_extension.reason: No target grid or deployment prediction-to-sample distance distribution is supplied. Do not call region-holdout scores map accuracy or claim kNNDM/AOA validation.

required_materials: fresh per-input/fold skill plans and real reviews
actual generated caller and task hashes
code_generation_audit.current_behavior: Copies a reviewed caller and plan.task; it neither selects variables scientifically nor implements nested spatial validation.
code_generation_audit.proposed_skills_work: Deterministic feature preparation, paired cohort and fold construction, development-only fitting, outer refit/evaluation, and optional joint coordinate permutation belong in reusable skill helpers, not numerical code added to workflows.
stop_conditions: Derived input/fold hashes or code binding missing
Outer labels or metrics reach inner selection
Different paired cohort/folds or unexplained effective seeds
Unverified data correction, private-path leakage or overwritten historical artifacts
code_generation_audit.storage: After review, real-data outputs use an external assets/results/<project_id>/ fresh task directory; per-run gen_script belongs with those results. The local workflow result tree remains synthetic-only.

unresolved.issue: No new independent external labels or complete regional predictor grid.
Reusable nested spatial orchestration and development-only/refit interfaces are not yet implemented or tested.
Derived inputs and paired masks have not been materialized or bound to a reviewed input hash.
Static environmental metadata do not fully represent meteorology/VOC chemistry or source-period uncertainty.
